message.content:
Silicone grease with over 90% PDMS: candidates are 3403 (lubricating preparations) or 3910 (silicones in primary forms). Heading 3403 covers lubricating preparations, but it excludes those containing 70% or more by weight of petroleum oils; the silicone grease contains no petroleum oils, so it is not excluded on that basis. Classification in 3403.19 covers preparations containing petroleum oils, while 3403.99 covers "other" preparations.

Known CBP rulings on silicone dielectric greases: some were classified in 3403.99.00 (other lubricating preparations), and others in 3910.00 when the product is a silicone in primary form. This product is a compound used to lubricate, seal, and insulate, and it is a preparation with filler and additives. Silicone grease with a silica thickener is typically a lubricating preparation in 3403.99.0000.

HTS 3403.99.00 has the statistical suffix 00, so the full code is 3403.99.0000.

```json
{"hts_code": "3403.99.0000", "reason": "A silicone dielectric grease (PDMS with silica filler and additives) with no petroleum oils is a lubricating preparation of heading 3403, falling under the 'other' subheading."}
```
